versions.statuteQuote: The landlord may not charge any liquidated damages.

summaryForModel: When a service member ends a lease early under § 55.1-1235, the landlord may not charge liquidated damages, such as a lease-break or early termination fee. A lease that charges one for a military termination conflicts with this.
paraphraseExamples: Service members terminating under the military clause shall pay one month's rent as liquidated damages.
Any early termination, including for military orders, requires a lease-break fee equal to two months' rent.
tenantExplanation: If you end your lease early because of military orders, your landlord can't charge you a lease-break fee.
action: You can ask your landlord to state that the lease-break fee does not apply to a military termination.
